description: Shared prefab classification rules — apply to ALL terrains on export. Rules MUST emit structured gameplay, spatial, and render.iconKey for Eden AI + glyphs. See t090_eden_ai_world_object_schema.md and t090_world_object_glyphs.md. EDITING THIS FILE CHANGES NOTHING UNTIL THE CATALOGUE IS REBUILT — packages/map-assets/<terrain>/objects/prefabs.json.gz is a committed artifact carrying the kind/class from the LAST run of `tbd-tools world build-objects`. A rule edit is latent until then, so the gates you run now are validating the rules, NOT the shipped catalogue; re-verify after a rebuild. Rules are evaluated in FILE ORDER and the FIRST rule with a matching match.resourceNameContains substring wins (case-sensitive), so APPEND new rules — an appended rule can only claim prefabs that currently fall through to `fallback`, which is what makes it safe. T-244 added the vehicle lane (Props/Wrecks/*) this way; note its `_turret` and CannonWreck rules must stay AHEAD of the vehicle rules, whose hull paths they would otherwise match.

ai.summary: Location composition prefab (whole-POI grouping entity); zero extents; children export as their own rows — never render.
Attached building part (entry, door, ladder, graffiti); belongs to a parent structure — not a standalone footprint.
Road/tourist/warning signage; no cover; concealment only.
Bridge railing segment; low hard cover along a bridge deck.
Road crash barrier; low hard cover; blocks vehicles.
Freestanding wall/fence segment (pole, net, wood, stone, brick, concrete, pipe); linear hard cover.
Pavement/sidewalk piece; flat surface, no cover.
Railway track segment; ground-level; minor vehicle obstacle.
Power pylon/pole; tall thin utility; negligible cover.
Lamp post / floodlight mast / runway light; light source at night.
Piping/culvert/drainage works; low utility structure.
Military training obstacle (bridge element of obstacle course); climbable hard cover.
Bridge span/pillar; crossable hard structure over water or gap; chokepoint.
Lighthouse; tall coastal landmark tower; excellent observation point.
Pier/dock/naval structure; walkable hard platform over water.
Cemetery/calvary monument (gravestones, crosses); low stone cover.
Castle/fortress wall, tower or ruin section; historic stone landmark; hard cover.
Rubble pile from a ruined house; low scramble cover, not a structure footprint.
Ruined structure shell (walls, corners, chimney); broken hard cover; partially enterable.
Civic building (church, chapel, fire station); prominent hard structure.
Garbage container; small street furniture; low cover.
Shipping/storage container; solid hard cover block; common at industrial and military sites.
Shed/outbuilding (garden, boat, bus, fisherman, metal); small enterable structure.
Garage; small vehicle structure; enterable hard cover.
Tent (camp/military); concealment only — no hard cover.
Tower structure (guard/deer stand/control/transmitter/water); elevated observation position.
Guard house/box; small military checkpoint structure.
Street/garden furniture (bench, board, clothesline, garden bed); minimal low cover.
Anthill mound; low soft mound; prone concealment.
Industrial installation (fuel tank, silo, factory hall, crane, transformer/weight/water station).
Fuel station building/canopy; roadside commercial structure.
Fuel pallet/barrel/crane spreader; small industrial prop; low cover.
Recreation furniture (playground, stadium fittings); low props.
Conifer tree; static vegetation; soft cover to ~4 m standing.
Deciduous tree; static vegetation; soft cover.
Paved road segment; no cover; vehicle route.
Residential building; hard cover; blocks movement and LOS.
Coastal palm tree; static vegetation; light soft cover.
Dead or burned tree; bare trunk; minimal soft cover.
Low shrub; prone/crouch concealment only; no ballistic protection.
Grass patch; prone concealment only; no protection.
Cliff or rock face prop; hard cover; blocks movement and LOS.
Standalone rock; hard cover; blocks movement and LOS.
Street lamp; tall thin pole; night light source; no real cover.
Radio antenna mast; tall landmark; climbable via service ladder.
Pier structure over water; walkable; no cover.
Barrier or roadblock; hard crouch/prone cover; blocks vehicles.
Sign on thin post; decoration; no cover or obstacle.
Military fortification obstacle (hedgehog, dragon teeth, trench segment); hard low cover; blocks vehicles.
Concrete bunker; heavy hard cover; enterable firing positions.
Military structure (barracks, guardhouse, base building); hard cover; enterable.
Agricultural building (barn, stable, granary); hard cover; large open interior.
Ruined structure; partial hard cover; broken walls and openings.
Cultural or civic structure (church, chapel, monument hall); hard cover; landmark.
Service building (fire station, municipal office, hotel); hard cover; enterable.
Industrial tower (light tower, water tower); tall thin landmark; minimal cover.
Industrial building (factory hall, warehouse, plant); hard cover; large footprint.
Commercial building (shop, booth, kiosk); hard cover; street-facing entrances.
Aircraft hangar; very large open hard-cover structure at an airfield.
Airfield control tower; tall landmark; overwatch position.
Airfield runway segment; wide flat surface; aircraft operations.
Forest-floor tree debris (stump, fallen trunk, branch); low soft cover prone only.
Conifer tree (spruce/pine); static vegetation; soft cover to ~4 m standing.
Deciduous tree (birch/hornbeam/fruit/alder/willow/poplar/lime); static vegetation; soft cover.
Granite rock or rock cluster; hard cover; blocks movement and LOS.
Unrecognized standalone structure; generic hard building footprint (needs a specific rule).
Blown-off vehicle turret lying separate from its hull; wreckage debris, NOT a vehicle (T-244) — must precede the Props/Wrecks/ vehicle rules, whose hull paths it would otherwise match.
Wrecked towed field gun; a weapon carriage, not a self-propelled vehicle (T-244) — stays prop/debris.
Derelict boat hull beached or grounded; hard cover behind the gunwale, no engine — static map geometry, never a spawnable craft.
Destroyed armoured hull (BMP-1 / M113 / T-62 / BTR-70); full hard cover and a hard vehicle obstacle — the strongest non-structure cover on open ground.
Burnt-out military cargo truck (M923 / Ural-4320); tall hard cover along the flank, blocks the lane it sits in.
Wrecked light wheeled vehicle (Skoda S105 / UAZ-469 / M151 / M998); crouch-height hard cover, blocks a road lane but not a standing man's silhouette.
Static vehicle wreck with no specific hull rule; generic vehicle-sized hard obstacle. Catch-all so a new terrain's wreck lands in the vehicle lane rather than the prop fallback.

Fixed exterior light fixture (fluorescent tube, wall lamp); a mounted utility fitting, not movable furniture — must precede the Props/Furniture/ rule whose path it shares. Glyph gap: the manifest has no utility-lamp icon, so it draws the utility-powerline pole.
World-editor generated powerline run (pylons + catenary); tall thin pole footprint, prone cover at the base only, never a vehicle obstacle.
Navigation, mooring or life buoy; floating or beached marker, no cover and no obstruction. Glyph gap: the manifest ships no water-* icon, so it draws prop-unknown until one exists.
Poster set or hanging pub/shop sign; flat signage face, no cover and no obstruction — must precede the Props/Commercial/ rule whose path it shares.
Anti-vehicle field obstacle (Czech hedgehog, barbed tape coil, concrete snow breaker); hard prone/crouch cover and a hard vehicle stop, infantry pass.
Light or training obstacle (traffic cone, vault/crawl/climb frame); marks or shapes movement without stopping a vehicle; frames are climbable.
Flat ground overlay (dirt/oil/marking decal, duckboard walkway); zero-height surface dressing — no cover, no line-of-sight effect, no obstruction.
Terrain-blending embankment shell (eroded dirt/forest berm); ground surface geometry giving prone cover on the lee side, never a vehicle obstacle.
Species bush (hazel, willow, juniper, rose, elder, reed); prone/crouch concealment only, no ballistic protection.
Herbaceous plant or weed clump (burdock, nettle, thistle, curbside weeds, seaweed); ankle-to-knee ground cover, prone concealment only.
Field crop row (cabbage, potato, pumpkin, tomato, capsicum); low cultivated ground cover, prone concealment only.
Farmyard fitting (beehive, hay bale/dryer, trough, milk can, scarecrow, water tank, weighing scale); waist-high clutter giving prone cover at most.
Civilian household or yard item (bottle, bucket, basket, cart, ladder, wheelbarrow, kerosene lamp, tool); small movable clutter, no meaningful cover.
Commercial fitting (market stand, beer keg); stall-height clutter giving prone cover at most.
Construction material stack (brick/plank/gravel pile, concrete pipe, cable reel, mixer, pallet jack); hard crouch cover, infantry-passable.
Wooden or cardboard crate/box stack; hard crouch cover when stacked, infantry-passable, no vehicle obstruction.
Decorative planter (flowerpot, street trough, pelargonia box); knee-high dressing, prone cover only.
Forestry stack or stand (cut wood pile, log, game feed rack, skull); hard crouch cover along the pile, infantry-passable.
Interior or terrace furniture (chair, stool, table, rack, chest, sunshade, bar tap); waist-high, prone cover at most.
Refuse (bin, cardboard, junk/litter pile, tyre pile, military garbage); low soft-to-hard clutter, prone cover only.
Industrial yard item (steel barrel, gas tank, concrete panel, pallet, MarsBox, repair gear); hard crouch cover, infantry-passable.
Harbour and fishing gear (net, net hanger, rope, lobster trap, winch); low quayside clutter, prone cover at most.
Beach and leisure item (lounger, air mattress, blanket, sunshade, pedal boat, caravan, paddle); low clutter, prone cover at most.
Public service fitting (mailbox, post office box and stand, fire extinguisher box); chest-high mounted box, prone cover only.
Detached vehicle part (tyre, tyre pile); wreckage debris, never a vehicle (T-244) — prone cover only.
Unclassified static map prop; needs classification rule.
